title: tylophora sublanceolata var. auriculata
intro: Tylophora sublanceolata var. auriculata, commonly known as Indian ipecacuanha or Indian tylophora, is a plant species of the genus Tylophora, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and anti-tubercular properties, as well as its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Tylophora sublanceolata var. auriculata include its expectorant properties, which help in relieving cough and congestion, and its anti-asthmatic effects, which aid in alleviating respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
